verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents a broad official SDK portfolio of 30 idiomatic SDKs (13 client-side, 13 server-side, 4 edge), including a Cloudflare edge SDK and official OpenFeature providers, and the community confirms a mobile client SDK. That covers backend, client and mobile delivery. The 'consistent flag behavior' part is only implied: community reports say clients download all flags and stream changes, and the rule system works over arbitrary contexts, but no first-party evidence explicitly guarantees consistent evaluation across SDKs. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of consistent evaluation semantics across SDKs, explicit naming of web and mobile SDKs in first-party docs, hands-on corroboration of cross-stack consistency.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use official SDKs across my whole stack — backend, web, and mobile — with consistent flag behavior
